qkv_m1_scheduler_comparison.conclusion: Data-parallel is fastest. Stream-K and Split-K reduction/reset overhead exceeds the benefit of additional K parallelism.

decode_summary.warning: Results use equivalent cold-L2 policies but separate executable and PyTorch harnesses.

qkv_m1_nsight.interpretation: Grid underfill and scoreboard dependencies limit the kernel. Stream-K increases parallelism but is slower because reduction/reset overhead dominates at this problem size.
